snippet.title: Luna Abyss - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Release Date Trailer for Luna Abyss, a first-person narrative-driven bullet-hell shooter developed by Kwalee Labs. Players will dive into the depths as Fawkes, a prisoner of Luna, who must fight her way through her prison sentence and come to terms with a foretold prophecy. Master platforming elements, take on larger-than-life bosses, and survive the onslaught of projectiles with ease. Luna Abyss is launching on May 21 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and Xbox on PC).
